name: custom-connectors

plugins.name: custom-connectors
plugins.description: Slack, Fathom, ClickUp, Vercel, AWS, Chrome DevTools and Figma connectors that replace their MCPs with direct calls, using your own tokens from the macOS Keychain

plugins.name: google-workspace
plugins.description: Optional, opt-in: Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail, Calendar and Tasks via the Google REST APIs with your own OAuth login. Needs a one-time Google Cloud setup. Not installed by custom-connectors.

description: Connectors that replace the Slack, Fathom, ClickUp, Vercel, AWS, Chrome DevTools and Figma MCPs with lightweight skills
